flows.title: From Registration to Audit-Ready Evidence
flows.description: The operations manager keeps registrations current, monitors advice-record quality, handles complaints and data-subject requests and produces evidence for inspections.
flows.trigger: A new advisor or office starts, a complaint or data-subject request arrives, or an FSMA or internal audit is announced.
flows.successSignal: Registrations, advice records, complaints and consent evidence are complete and exportable, and audit findings are closed.

steps.title: Keep FSMA registrations current
keyFacts: Every office and advisor is tracked against the FSMA registers of credit intermediaries (mortgage and consumer credit) and insurance intermediaries, with certificates, responsible persons and renewal dates; the academy feeds new certifications.
Changes (new offices, leavers, Meilleurtaux office integration) trigger register updates.
painPoints: Advisors who left are still listed, or new ones advise before their registration is confirmed.

dependencies.name: Compliance, Complaints and Audit Trail
dependencies.how: Tracks registrations, responsible persons and renewal dates.

dependencies.name: Office and Franchise Management
dependencies.how: Holds the FSMA registration of each office and expert and checks it periodically against the FSMA registers.

dependencies.name: Academy Learning and Certification
dependencies.how: Supplies certificates and certification dates.

steps.title: Monitor advice-record quality
keyFacts: Advice records are sampled per office and advisor for completeness (needs, alternatives, suitability reasoning, buyer confirmation) and for deviations between advice and concluded product.
Findings go back to offices and the academy as training input.
painPoints: Records completed after the deed are indistinguishable from records written at advice time unless timestamps are checked.

dependencies.name: Advice Record and Suitability Assessment
dependencies.how: Provides the records and timestamps for sampling.

dependencies.name: Analytics and Data Platform
dependencies.how: Reports completeness and deviation rates per office.

steps.title: Manage consent and data-subject requests
keyFacts: Consent for processing income, identity, health and meter data and for monitoring contracts is recorded per household and brand; access, rectification and erasure requests are handled within the GDPR deadlines with the vault and care desk data.
Retention rules keep intermediary records for the required period and delete the rest.
painPoints: Households who consented on one brand object to being contacted by another.
Erasure requests conflict with the record-keeping duties of a credit intermediary.

dependencies.name: Identity, Consent and Access Control
dependencies.how: Stores and evaluates consent per household and purpose.

dependencies.name: Household Contract Vault and Customer Account
dependencies.how: Provides the household's data for access and erasure requests.

steps.title: Handle complaints within the rules
keyFacts: Complaints from any channel are registered, acknowledged, investigated with the file and advice record, answered within the internal deadline and reported, with the FPS Economy Economic Inspectorate and the FSMA as supervisory authorities.
painPoints: Complaints raised in an office by phone never reach the register.

dependencies.name: Compliance, Complaints and Audit Trail
dependencies.how: Registers, tracks and reports complaints.

dependencies.name: Customer-Care Ticketing and Omnichannel Inbox
dependencies.how: Flags customer-care tickets as complaints into the register.

steps.title: Produce audit evidence and close findings
keyFacts: The audit trail across workbench, care desk, vault and integrations is exported per period, office or household for FSMA inspections and internal audits; findings are tracked to closure and compliance audit findings is a supporting KPI.
painPoints: Evidence is scattered across systems and assembled by hand under time pressure.

dependencies.name: Compliance, Complaints and Audit Trail
dependencies.how: Exports the audit trail and tracks findings to closure.

dependencies.name: Integration Gateway
dependencies.how: Supplies logs of submissions, orders and document exchanges.
